name: Pokémon Contingency Contract: Operation Masquerade
summary: Based on the Contingency Contract gamemode from the Arknights games. Tiana has gotten an invite to a convention, with a whole new battle experience as its main feature. Set battle modifiers, change your teams and customize your Pokemon, and aim to reach the highest score you can! Gamble your hard earned credits on obtaining new pokemon, items, and unlocking their full potential, or simply enjoy your time at the convention.
